title: Fodor's Pressing-Down Lemma for Regular Cardinals (1 sorry)

problemStatement.formal: Complete 1 sorry in CantorDiagonalizationOQ02OQ03OQ02.lean: prove diagInter_isUnbounded by formalizing that the diagonal intersection of club sets on a regular cardinal is itself unbounded (club)
problemStatement.plain: Fodor's Pressing-Down Lemma (1956): every regressive function on a stationary subset of an uncountable regular cardinal is constant on a stationary set. The file has 1 sorry in the proof of diagInter_isUnbounded — that the diagonal intersection of a club sequence is unbounded. This requires showing the intersection is nonempty at each regular cardinal step.
